core_obligations: Induction hypothesis (proof line 655-656): assume rank(beta) = beta for all beta in alpha.

Two-step evaluation (lines 657-660): rank(alpha) = supstrict over beta in alpha of rank(beta) = supstrict over beta in alpha of beta = alpha, the first equality the displayed definition of rank as strict supremum and the second the hypothesis, the last the defining property of an ordinal as the strict sup of its smaller ordinals.
proof_roadmap: Assume the identity below alpha by induction.
Rewrite rank(alpha) through the supremum characterisation.
Substitute the hypothesis and collapse to alpha.
